acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, significant kitchen lighting upgrades often require electrical permits in cities such as Daly City, South San Francisco, and other Bay Area municipalities. This is especially true if the project involves altering existing wiring, adding new circuits, or changing the electrical load. Permits ensure that the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. As your general contractor, we will guide you through the permit application process and ensure all work meets the necessary regulations for your specific location.
